Project status

About Radio Client

Radio Client has its own identity, built around vintage radio design, crimson-and-black art direction, theatrical details, and subtle broadcast-inspired effects.

Current stage: interface scaffoldThe page is a functional static preview, not a playable Minecraft client.
Engine: not connectedNext major milestone is selecting a legally reusable engine/base and establishing a reproducible build.
Redistribution: not clearedWe still need to verify the relevant licenses before publishing a playable build.
Fan-inspired visual direction drawing on Alastor from Hazbin Hotel. This is an unofficial fan-inspired project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the show’s creators. The page is a UI prototype, not a playable Minecraft implementation.
